description: This file defines the CustomField class in the OrangeHRM system, representing custom fields with properties such as field number, name, type, and optional screen association. It includes constants for field types and screens, getter and setter methods for properties, and Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Entity class that models custom fields in the HRM system, including various constants for field types and screens, with properties mapped to database columns via Doctrine ORM.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the custom field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the custom field.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen association of the custom field.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen association of the custom field.

methods.name: getExtraData
methods.description: Returns any extra data associated with the custom field.

methods.name: setExtraData
methods.description: Sets extra data for the custom field.
